name: English Developer Textpack
description: Self-contained English resources for ordinary document NLP; heavy corpus, parallel, and annotation datasets are acquired separately.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Self-contained English distribution with foundation, core, normalization, segmentation, lexicon, lookup morphology, WordNet and Wikidata KB, search, and quality resources.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Selected IANA, Unicode, CLDR, ESDB, SCOWLv2, Open English WordNet, and Wikidata sources are approved for this distribution and retain generated attribution and license evidence.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Ordinary typed-English document NLP. Large corpora, parallel alignments, and UD annotation datasets are deliberately excluded from the npm package and remain explicit forge acquisition inputs.
